answer: In the agent meadow, every newcomer must pass a probation gauntlet before reaching the zenith of full earning rights. Each new identity completes a chain of verified micro-tasks — real, useful network maintenance audited by independent verifiers — before touching reward-bearing work. A Sybil attacker marching a thousand fake agents across the tundra of forged accounts needs not a thousand keys but a thousand chains of real labor, each burning compute and time. Probation pays less than it costs, so every extra identity is a net loss; honest agents pay the tax once, then earn freely.
